name: MathVision
intro: MATH-Vision (MATH-V) 是一个精心策划的数据集，旨在评估大型多模态模型（LMMs）在视觉背景下的数学推理能力。它包含3,040个高质量的数学问题，这些问题来源于真实的数学竞赛，涵盖16个不同的数学学科和5个难度级别。该数据集揭示了当前LMMs与人类在MATH-V上的显著性能差距，并提供了详细的分类以指导未来的研究和开发。
org: The Chinese University of Hong Kong, SenseTime, Shanghai AI Laboratory
build_method: 真实竞赛题采集、Mathpix 抽取、四阶段人工策展
task_type: 图像问答, 数学问题解决
eval_feature: 官方响应解析、数学等价判分、按学科与难度统计
official_license: MIT (official repository and Hugging Face dataset card)
build_method_en: Real competition collection, Mathpix extraction, four-stage human curation
eval_feature_en: Official response parsing, mathematical-equivalence scoring, subject/level breakdowns
intro_en: MATH-Vision (MATH-V) is a carefully curated dataset designed to evaluate the mathematical reasoning abilities of large multimodal models (LMMs) in visual contexts. It contains 3,040 high-quality math problems sourced from real math competitions, covering 16 different mathematical subjects and 5 difficulty levels. The dataset highlights the significant performance gap between current LMMs and humans on MATH-V and provides detailed categorizations to guide future research and development.

drawio_review_note: Source audit locked to arXiv:2402.14804v1 (the only arXiv revision available on 2026-07-21), official Git commit a1f5cc3add200c0cd080fad463e500f44ef1fb41, and Hugging Face revision 2837ddb3f13abaf6b3997c12d80753e5470bd46a. The diagram preserves the paper's two-stage source collection; visual-input and categorizable-level competition gate; 19 competitions; copyright, redistribution, and answer-retrievability controls; Mathpix extraction of 9,000 questions with 3,500 image-context items; ten senior STEM annotators; Stage-1 alignment/content review to 3,352; repair by recapturing incomplete or mispositioned images; lexical-overlap plus Levenshtein duplicate screening and manual removal to 3,040; three-group subject labeling with GPT-4V/Gemini Pro advice and expert consolidation into 16 subjects; and the actual fourth curation stage, five-level grade mapping followed by manual boundary correction. It also preserves the released 1,532 multiple-choice/1,508 free-form composition and 304-item testmini. Evaluation follows the pinned code: model-specific boxed-answer prompting; terminal choice/number handling; last-box or answer-phrase parsing; find_math_answer cleanup; equality against either the gold letter or its option text; rejection of empty answers; tuple/LaTeX expression evaluation rounded to two decimals; and overall, subject, level, and subject-level accuracy over every evaluated row. The paper does not disclose how the 304 testmini rows were sampled. Paper Table 1 reports 3,472 unique images, whereas the pinned repository/HF release exposes one combined image file per 3,040 row, so the diagram does not conflate those counts. The official repository and dataset card declare MIT; the paper separately states that collection respected each source's copyright and redistribution restrictions. Formal publication evidence [site-a11r-paper-alignment]: normalized Draw.io and architecture sidecars plus native fixed-light SVG/PNG pairs were regenerated from the checked-in bilingual specs. Final PNG dimensions are 1885×1241 (English) and 1885×1241 (Chinese); SVG viewBoxes are 1883×1239 and 1883×1239. The final exports were inspected without clipping, node overlap, connector-node crossing, fallback text, or adaptive colors.
